one_liner: The Golden State Warriors' most-used player by total minutes across the 3-season sample is Brandin Podziemski (6,018.4 minutes), not Stephen Curry.
three_things: Brandin Podziemski leads the team in total minutes at 6,018.4, so the minutes-based 'top contributor' is a young wing, not the franchise star.
The team scored 114.6 points per game in the latest season at a 101.7 pace proxy.
context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for the team across the sample, not necessarily the best or highest-scoring player -- so a high-minutes role player can outrank a star with heavier per-game impact but fewer minutes. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes and is a raw box rate, not an impact metric. ppg_latest_season is a single-season team average while the rest of the sample spans three seasons; pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only with no schedule or opponent adjustment.
